p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6401dcd4.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda color: sum(row.count(color) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            area = (r1 - r0 + 1) * (c1 - c0 + 1)
            if area >= 4 and len(cells) / area >= 0.65:
                for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                    for x in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
